title: Artificial Intelligence Researcher
company: Beijing Foreign Enterprise Management Consultants Co.,Ltd.
job_description: On behalf of Huawei, a world-renowned information and communication technology company, we are seeking passionate and talented individuals to join our team as Artificial Intelligence Researchers. Job Description: Conduct cutting-edge research in the field of recommendation & search, natural language processing and deep learning &LLM. Develop AI-enabled products and services with other groups in the company. Collaborate with world-class organizations in academia projects. Skills / Qualifications: Possess a PhD degree in computer science, statistics, applied mathematics, or have equivalent research experiences. Demonstrate the ability to generate new ideas and innovate. Have 3 years of academic or industrial working experiences in recommendation & search, natural language processing, deep learning, machine learning, or related fields. Have strong programming skills, experienced in one or more programming languages including but not limited to: C/C++, Java, Python.
